page.overview:
Who is Gerard Troyden?

Gerard was the king of Kovir and the son of Gedovius and Gemma, as well as the last to carry the family name. He had five children: Anna, Alicja, and three unnamed sons, but they all tragically died except for Alicja.

He granted young Guido Thyssen a favor by giving him a title of Margrave of East March and, later, giving the hand of his youngest daughter Alicja to Edmund Thyssen.
